directory, the root scan and the dispatch, taken from the coordinator session's own log (commands, their outputs
and timestamps only).

steps.command:
S=<scratch>; X=$S/convergence-prompt-audit/x9-round2; cmp $S/wt-x9-g/CLAUDE.md $X/arms/CLAUDE.g.md && cmp $S/wt-x9-c/CLAUDE.md $X/arms/CLAUDE.c.md && cmp $S/wt-x9-0/CLAUDE.md $X/arms/CLAUDE.0.md && echo "arms match the worktrees" && cd ~/code/native-agent-stack && \
git worktree remove --force <scratch>/wt-x9-g && \
git worktree remove --force <scratch>/wt-x9-c && \
git worktree remove <scratch>/wt-x9-0 && \
git worktree remove <scratch>/wt-x9r2-base && \
git worktree remove <scratch>/wt-pa-pr1 && \
git worktree remove <scratch>/wt-audit-base && \
test "$(git rev-parse claude/prompt-audit-instructions-20260927)" = 8a5850ab2e7fbf17344cd85826022da98e35c702 && \
git worktree remove <scratch>/wt-pa-pr2 && \
git worktree prune && git worktree list | grep -c 789daede; git rev-parse --short claude/prompt-audit-instructions-20260927

S=<scratch>; EXPECT="body.txt c.go checks.txt convergence-prompt-audit cookbook_sha.txt err.txt j2 m.go make_proposed.py pages prompt-audit-adjudication prompt-audit-adjudication-runs prompt-audit-x9-round2-judgment prompt-audit-x9-round2-runs proposed readme.txt template_hashes.py templates.f2_f3.json templates.f2_only.json templates.f3_only.json verify web-supp"; test "$(ls -A1 $S | sort | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/ $//')" = "$EXPECT" && mkdir $S/.hold && for n in body.txt c.go checks.txt convergence-prompt-audit cookbook_sha.txt err.txt m.go make_proposed.py pages prompt-audit-adjudication prompt-audit-adjudication-runs prompt-audit-x9-round2-judgment prompt-audit-x9-round2-runs proposed readme.txt template_hashes.py templates.f2_f3.json templates.f2_only.json templates.f3_only.json verify web-supp; do mv "$S/$n" "$S/.hold/$n"; done; ls -A1 $S; ls -A1 $S/.hold | wc -l; chmod 700 $S/.hold; ls -A $S/j2 $S/j2/x9
